description: Keep Git Graph Studio's symbol index and semantic diff checks synchronized with Claude Code edits.

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const p=j.tool_input?.file_path||j.tool_input?.path||'';if(p){console.log(JSON.stringify({additionalContext:'File modified ('+p+'). Call mcp__ggs__index_refresh(paths:[...]) before running symbol_references, git_diff_impact, analysis_dead_code, or analysis_security so the index reflects your edit.'}));}}catch{}});"
